vegetation_cover.source: CLMS HRL Tree Cover Density 2023 + Herbaceous Cover 2023

surface_temperature.source: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
surface_temperature.quality: QA_PIXEL applied; median composition of valid summer observations
surface_temperature.composite_method: Per-pixel median of every valid QA-screened summer observation

limitations.vegetation: coverage presence, not biodiversity, habitat quality or fuel load
limitations.temperature: detailed satellite surface temperature at acquisition time; not air temperature, personal exposure or a climatic normal
